Home.originTitle: A map that began at a reading group.
Home.originText: This project grew out of a mystery book discussion. Everyone brought intriguing recommendations and stories, leaving two questions: what should I read next, and where can I meet people who share the interest? Mystère Atlas starts with a works catalog and Paris events, connecting those clues one by one.
